# Formalini developer reference

Formalini connects uploaded page images to structured document fields that applications can retrieve, correct, and dispatch through configured workflows.

Official documentation: https://formalini.com/docs
Account signup: https://formalini.com/auth
Worked demo: https://formalini.com/demo
Pricing and usage: https://formalini.com/pricing
API base URL: https://api.formalini.com/api/public/v1
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <FORMALINI_API_KEY>
Scopes: documents.read, documents.write, workflows.run

Endpoints:
- GET /documents: list; limit 1–100, optional status filter.
- POST /documents: create with name and optional fields.
- POST /documents/upload: upload 1–25 JPEG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC page images as repeated multipart file fields. PDF must first be rendered to images.
- GET /documents/{id}: retrieve a document and its fields.
- PATCH /documents/{id}: correct fields or change status.
- POST /workflows/dispatch: send a documented event for a document.

The upload endpoint may return HTTP 402 for exhausted credits, storage, or daily allowance. HTTP 429 means the per-minute rate limit was reached; honor Retry-After. Mutating requests are not automatically retried because idempotency support is not documented.

Repository entry points:
- README.md
- docs/quickstart.md
- docs/api-contract-report.md
- openapi/formalini-public-v1.yaml
- examples/README.md
- sdks/python, sdks/javascript, sdks/php, sdks/dotnet, sdks/java, sdks/go, sdks/ruby, sdks/rust

The SDKs and examples are Apache-2.0 licensed. The hosted Formalini service needs an account and key. Keep keys server-side. SDK packages have not yet been published to registries. Published docs are the contract; an adjacent older server checkout has different host and shapes.
